name: ntfy
description: Send push notifications to your phone or desktop with a simple HTTP PUT — no account needed. Subscribe to topics from the official apps.
compose:
services:
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    command: serve
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    volumes:
      - ./cache:/var/cache/ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
